's Maritime Solutions won a $796K U.S. Navy contract action for maintenance, modernization, and repairs to the USS Thomas Hudner.
The work covers the ship’s fiscal 2027 docking restricted availability, including labor, equipment, testing, and quality assurance.
The contract includes options that, if exercised, could raise its cumulative value to $106.8M.
The work will be performed in Mayport, Florida, and is expected to be completed by January 2028.
The Naval Sea Systems Command is overseeing the contract, with $796K in fiscal 2025 Navy procurement funds obligated at award.

title: BAE System wins $106.8M potential Navy deal for USS Hudner repairs
